description:
AgroSylvaNova is a Geospatial innovation team transforming NASA Earth observation data into solutions for sustainable agriculture and forestry. We aim to combine GIS, remote sensing, and scientific research to address real-world environmental challenges.

We're looking for teammates with skills in:
• GIS & Remote Sensing
• Agriculture & Forestry
• AI/ML & Programming
• Data Science & Visualization
• Media, Design & Storytelling

Join us to turn Geospatial intelligence into meaningful impact!
summary: TerraTwin is an advanced, farmer-first agritech platform designed to combat climate degradation and water scarcity in vulnerable agricultural regions like Pakistan and globally. By bridging NASA Earth observation data (SMAP, GPM/IMERG, MODIS, Landsat, SRTM, ECOSTRESS) with localized farming traditions, TerraTwin translates complex satellite telemetry into a simple, story-driven decision engine (Problem\Action\Benefit). It features HD Esri satellite imagery, custom farm polygon mapping, dual-strategy recommendations (NASA-optimal vs. Traditional local practices), and Urdu localization to build absolute trust with farmers.
details:
What it does & How it works: TerraTwin analyzes real-time and historical NASA satellite signals to assess soil moisture (SMAP), precipitation (GPM), land surface temperature (ECOSTRESS), and vegetation health (MODIS). It presents this data through a clean, non-overwhelming interface where farmers and planners can inspect their exact land via interactive custom polygon drawing or flexible geospatial vector uploads (such as GeoJSON and .shp).

Dual-Strategy Adaptation: Instead of forcing unfamiliar western methods, TerraTwin provides a dual-recommendation matrix comparing modern NASA-optimized crop rotations with trusted traditional Pakistani farming practices.

Technologies Used: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Esri World Imagery Tile Servers, NASA POWER & Earth Data APIs, and client-side geospatial projection libraries (supporting multi-format vector mapping).

Super Intelligence (SI) & Tool Transparency: AI assistants (including Claude) were utilized during the development workflow for ideation, architectural structuring, code debugging, technical documentation drafting, and Urdu localization to ensure a seamless, high-performance user experience.
